Emily (PM): quick thread: pricing for committed capacity + burst packs. Need tradeoffs before docs update. TL;DR: three options I sketched. Need sales/finance/eng/legal input.

Sam (Sales): From sales: customers ask for soft caps and pay-as-you-go burst; want a clear overage calc and simple SKU. Examples: "commit 100k tokens/month + burst on demand".

Deepak (Eng): Capacity note: burst is tricky. We can autoscale but latency and preemption risk increase. Realistic safe burst = 1.5-2x committed for hosted; dedicated can do higher. Batching and cache affect cost.

Marta (Finance): Financial rules to consider: base commit price P, burst at multiplier 1.8-2.5x per-token. Optionally pre-bundled burst credits that expire after 90 days. Prefer predictable revenue (bundles) over pure PAYG.

Alexa (Legal): Legal check: define "burst credits" in contract, expiry, refunds, and SLA under throttling. Also need clause for data residency when bursting to other regions.

Sam (Sales): Typical asks from prospects:
• soft cap with alerts
• auto-burst for short periods (minutes)
• pre-bought burst credits at discount
• priority routing add-on

Emily (PM): Proposed options (high level):
A) Commit + PAYG burst (no cap)
B) Commit + soft cap + auto-throttle above cap
C) Commit + pre-bundled burst credits (tiered discounts)
Which should we prototype?

Deepak (Eng): Engineering preference = C for predictability. A is simplest to implement but may cause capacity contention. B requires throttle policies, per-tenant queueing and customer opt-in.

Marta (Finance): Finance leans C as well. Suggest pricing: base price = $X/1M tokens, burst credit price = 1.8x base. For annual contracts allow rollover up to 30% of committed tokens.

Alexa (Legal): We need explicit language for expiry and non-refundability for credits beyond grace. Also specify fallback behavior if capacity constrained (throttle vs degrade quality).

Sam (Sales): Negotiation levers to include: volume discounts on burst packs, priority routing as an add-on, and temporary free burst credit for onboarding.

Emily (PM): Launch criteria draft:
- Pricing matrix and SKUs documented
- Billing changes for burst tracking implemented
- Quota/enforcement + telemetry
- Legal T&C drafted
Target: beta with 3 pilot customers in ~6 weeks.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-5124 for quota/enforcement work. https://tracker.internal/INF-5124

Sam (Sales): I'll line up pilots: XenoHealth, RecipeAI, ClearMate — will confirm SOWs.

Emily (PM): Action items: Marta -> financial model, Deepak -> spec for enforcement, Alexa -> contract clauses, Sam -> pilot SOWs. I'll consolidate and share by EOD Friday :rocket:
